question: How does abandoning the five egoisms relate to the fear arising from fivefold coming and going?
premises: There is fear of coming and going.
inference: Freedom from the five egoisms overcomes the fear rooted in fivefold transmigratory existence.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of the five egoisms is not specified.
plain_english: Those who have abandoned the five egoisms are beyond the fear of coming and going inherent in fivefold nature.
